name: Basilica of San Francisco, La Paz
scope: The surviving carved-stone exterior of the basilica and its single bell tower at Plaza San Francisco in La Paz.
era: Standing basilica exterior and the late nineteenth-century bell tower documented in the 1914 printed stereograph.

stories.title: Basilica of San Francisco, La Paz

originalReview.notes: Both original views, the numbered caption and Underwood publisher imprint show the Plaza San Francisco church with its complete single bell tower. The Library of Congress catalogue records New York publication in 1914 and no known restrictions.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. Its images were not marked public domain or CC0. The selected Library of Congress original print is dated 1914 with no known restrictions.
